༄༅/ /yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las/rtsa gsum spyi'i rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las/ rtsa gsum spyi'i rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gsung gi dbang phyug rta mchog dpal// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// 'phags zhabs rdo rje'i gsung nyid la// mtshams sbyor mdzes pa'i rgyan 'di bstar// yi dam dgongs 'dus dbang chen zhi drag spyi'i byin rlabs 'pho ba rjes gnang gi cho ga /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs pad+ma'i sdong po las 'byung ba 'di nyid/ chos longs sprul gsum/ rta mgrin phyi nang gsang ba/ khyung dang mkha' 'gro /chos skyong skor thams cad la mngon rtogs dang sngags kyi kha bsgyur nas bskur chog cing*/ de'ang de dag gi dbang chen sngon du thob pa zhig gis 'di nyid sgrub thabs pad sdong dang sbrel ba'i rgyun gcig tsam thob nas gang 'dod bskur chog par mngon pas khungs che zhing bya sla bas/ 'dir zhi drag spyi 'gro'i lag len gyi chings su 'bri na/ sbyor ba stegs bu'i steng du dkyil 'khor ras bris sam lha grangs tshom bu bkod pa tsam gyis kyang 'thus/ de'i steng mañji'i khar bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs thag bum rdzas kyi bcud dang ldan pa/ mdun du zhi drag gang yin gyi zlum gtor ram/ dpal gtor rgyan ldan dang*/ gtso bo'i sku tsaka dang phyag mtshan/ g.yas su zhi ba la dar dang rin chen rgyan/ khro bo la dpal gyi chas/ rgyab tu bgrang phreng dang sngags byang*/ g.yon du phrin las bzhi'i tsaka li rnams bkod/ mtha' skor du sman raka gtor gsum/ nyer spyod/ chos srung gi gtor ma dang tshogs kyi chas/ chad brtan/ sngon gtor sogs 'du bya'o// dngos gzhi sgrub thabs pad sdong dngos la mtshon na bdag bskyed 'od dpag med gang rung bzlas pa bcas bya/ de nas gzhung gsal bum pa bskyed cing 'og nas 'byung ba'i spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs rgyas par byas la dzap bsnyen ci 'grub bzlas dmigs rgyas par sbyar/ mthar mchod bstod dang srung ma'i gtor 'bul sogs bya/ rta mgrin thugs dril gsang ba gcig 'grub la mtshon na las byang gis bdag mdun dbyer med bzlas pa bcas grub nas/

bum pa bigh+nāṃ gyis bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa bh+rūm̐ ser po las/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ rke phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ rin po che sna bdun las grub pa/ lha rdzas gos kyis mgul chings dang dar dpyang dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ rig pa ye shes kyi rdo rje la thugs rje ye shes lnga'i gzungs thag dang ldan pa/ nang dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zla gam dbang drag 'bar ba'i klong chen por dregs pa nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ khro bo chen po rta mgrin dbang chen yab yum gnas gsum gyi lha dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs kar 'od dpag med thugs srog phyag mtshan bcas par snying pos bskor ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od kyi bdud rtsi'i 'phro 'dus bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs la snying po bzla'o// las bum gyi chu'ang*/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs dang chos srung rnams la gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba dang*/ tshogs mchod kyi bar bya/ bdag 'jug len pa'am rig pa'i me tog dor/ de ltar dbang sgrub kyi tshul 'dis dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor rgyas pa sogs zhi drag gzhan la'ang mtshon par bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ thun brab cing bka' bsgo'am drag sngags brjod la bgegs bskrad/ me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa'i rdzogs byang gi go 'phang la 'god par bya ba'i ched du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pa'i byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa zab mo zhu snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan par zhu/

de'ang dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog tu gyur pa dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du me tog pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan pa grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob nas 'gro ba yongs kyi don mdzad pa des o rgyan he ru ka'i 'du khang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ gsang sngags phyi nang ma lus pa gu ru la gtad cing*/ khyad par pad+ma gsung gi rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa bstsal pa la brten nas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis brnyes shing*/ 'gro ba mtha' klas pa smin grol du mdzad pa las/ khyad par dbang chen 'dus pa sku yi rgyud/ rta mchog rol pa gsung gi rgyud/ rdo rje pad drwa thugs kyi rgyud la sogs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las/ phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ man ngag rgyud chen snang stong dbyer med 'khor 'das rang grol dang bcas pa'i rgyud chen 'di rnams la brten nas yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa mdzad pa yin la/ de yang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa la 'du/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa ni pad+ma dbang chen kho na la 'dus shing*/ yi dam de'i dgongs pa dam chos 'di la 'dus pas na/ yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa zhes bya ste mdor na rgyud lung man ngag theg dgu thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa yin la/ rgya gar za hor gyi yul du 'khor 'bangs spyi la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho gnang*/ rgyal po btsun mo nang blon rnams la yi dam dgongs 'dus nang skor rnams gtsigs su gnang*/ gsang skor man+dā ra ba kho na la gnang*/ bal yul du bal rje 'bangs dang bcas pa la sgyu 'phrul dgongs 'dus gnang*/ lha lcam dkon pa skyes na raka nas drang bar mdzad/

ba su dha ra la rta mgrin gyi rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag gnang*/ shākya de ma la mkha' 'gro'i skor gnang ste de dag smin grol du bkod/ gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs te mtha' 'khob kyi skye 'gro rnams/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag po yab yum gyi sgo nas smin grol du mdzad cing lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams dbang chen rdo rje srin po'i gzi byin gyis btul zhing dam la btags/ rgyal po'i thugs dam dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i thog mar ar+ya pā lo rta mgrin gyi gling bzhengs su gsol bas sa gzhi dul zhing bar chad thams cad zhi nas/ thugs dam gyi gtsug lag gegs med du 'byongs pa de dag gi skabs su slob dpon chen po'i rta mgrin gyi chos skor du ma zhig /rje 'bangs tha dad kyi skal ba dang 'tsham par gnang ba la/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta mgrin gyi sku dngos su bzhengs te rta skad 'dzam gling khyab par bsgrags pas mtshon dbang chen grub pa'i skyes bu du ma rgyun ma chad par byung zhing*/ zab chos rnams ma 'ongs pa'i don du gter gnas kun tu khyab par sbas pa las/ thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pa 'di ni/ mchims phu dge'u gong dang*/ ti gro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang*/ lho brag dung gi phug pa la sogs par/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po/ shes rab mkhar chen mtsho rgyal/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'bre yi chos blo mgon po/ chos rgyal mu ne btsan po la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor las can dag pa'i mched po bcu bdun la gsungs shing*/ mtsho rgyal gyis bka'i bsdu ba po byas nas yi dam dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs grub pa'i gnas chen pad+mo bkod pa'i byang gling dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal pha bang phag sdig khyung gsum gyi nang du/ bka' yi srung ma ma mgon dam can gnod sbyin gyi tshogs la gnyer du gtad de/

ār+ya chos blo mgon po'i skye mtha' dang 'phrad par smon lam btab ste sbas pa las/ phyi ma'i dus na ji ltar 'byung ba'i dus rtags lung byang dang rjes su mthun par ār+ya sa la'i skye ba phyi ma 'bre ban chos blo mgon po'i rnam 'phrul/ gter ston grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur ba o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa'am/ stag sham nus ldan rdo rjes spyan drangs te bka' bab las 'phro can gyi chos bdag rnams la rim par bstsal te skal ldan spyi dang*/ khyad par sbas pa'i yul gyi skye dgu mtha' dag smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i zab chos khyad par du mas 'phags shing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa 'di la rtsa gsum chos srung bcas pa'i dbang bka' rgyas bsdus ji snyed bzhugs pa las/ da lam 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi gdams ngag dang sbrel te che ge mo 'i byin rlabs 'pho ba'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par bgyi ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / slob dpon nyid rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rang gzugs su 'du shes pa'i dag snang brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang: bdag nyid chen po rang 'grub phyir: byin rlabs thugs rjes bdag dgongs nas: sku gsum byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig: ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug / rgyud rnam par dag par bsgrub pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mchog gsum yongs su 'dus pa bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i bcom ldan 'das che ge mo 'i lha tshogs mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bdun rnam par dag pa sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa dang dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du blangs nas bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

mchog gsum yongs 'dus che ge mo 'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams// 'dir gshegs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sdig bshags skyabs mchi mdzad la rang*// 'gro phan byang chub sems bskyed cing*// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// rnam par grol ba 'thob rgyur bsngo// bla med sdom pa bzung bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god cing tha mal gyi rtog pa bsal phyir snod bcud phung khams dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor sbyangs te byin dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob ma rnams la las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing*/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ snod bcud phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes zhi drag gang yin gyi gtso bo bskyed/ dbang skur byed rdo rje slob dpon la'ang tha mal gyi 'du shes spangs te skyabs gnas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor shes pas/ dag pa'i mos gus thun mong ma yin pa bskyed cing gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa bcom ldan 'das che ge mo 'i lha tshogs kyi rnam pa bla ma'i thugs las spros te khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / spos sbyor rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ snying po'i mthar/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ e ā ral+li hrīng hrīng pheṃ pheṃ zhes brjod cing spro na spyan 'dren byin 'beb kyi tshigs bcad kyang brjod/ de ltar ye shes pa phebs pa de nyid brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur bgyid pa la sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba'i dang por sku dbang bum pas bskur ba ni/ bum pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gzhal yas khang gi nang du bcom ldan 'das

che ge mo 'i lha tshogs ma lus pa dngos su bzhugs pa spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe/ lha rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur zhing khrus byas/ bum chu myang ba la brten nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag cing lus snang stong lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ bum pa ye shes gzhal yas su// sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi// thabs la dbyings byon bzhugs par 'tshal// snang stong lha yi dbang thob shog / rtsa sngags sham bur/ oṃ kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur pas lus gang chu lhag gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs bdag che ge mo sa dbu brgyan par gyur/ slar yang slob dpon nyid bcom ldan 'das che ge mo ra gsal ba'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i lha tshogs 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas sku yi byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa yongs su thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sku gzugs kyi tsaka li spyi bor bzhag cing*/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas// sku 'phros lus la 'jug pa ni// sku yi lhag pa'i ting 'dzin de// sku yi byin rlabs khyod la 'pho/ khyod dang gnyis med brtan par gyur// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor bas sku yi byin rlabs de nyid brtan par bya/ gnyis pa gsung dbang sngags phreng gi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs srog /hrīḥ sogs gang yin gyi/ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las sngags phreng 'phros zhal nas thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs nas/ rang lha'i sngags phreng dang gnyis med du gyur nas grags stong gsang ba sngags kyi sgra chen po sgrog pa'i mos pas sngags 'di yi rjes zlos byar gzhug /sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i// sngags kyi phreng ba las 'phros sngags// ngag gi sngags la 'jug pa ni// sngags kyi dngos grub khyod la 'pho/

khyod kyis dngos grub thob par shog / rtsa sngags sham bur/ oṃ wā ka sid+dhi hoḥ phreng ba mgrin pa dang lag tu sbyin la/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags bcas// ma lus khyod kyis 'grub gyur nas// ngag gi nus pa brtan pa dang*// dngos grub dam pa thob gyur cig /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor bas gsung gi byin rlabs mchog tu brtan par bya'o// gsum pa thugs dbang gtor mas bskur ba ni/ de nas khyed rang gi sems nyid 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i sems skad cig ma la gang gis kyang ma bslad pa'i ngo bo rig stong rang gnas rjen pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog cig /de'i ngang las mi dmigs pa'i dmigs pa rang bzhin 'gag med kyi rtsal snang du shar ba'i dpal gyi gtor ma 'di nyid che ge mo 'i lha tshogs su gsal ba'i thugs kyi thig le las 'phros pa'i byin rlabs ye shes kyi thig le khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ rig stong spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su ro mnyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi thig le las 'phros pa'i// thig le yid la bstim pa ni// chos kyi thig ler rgyas gdab pas// thugs kyi rtog pa rtogs par 'gyur// phyag rgya chen por grol gyur cig /

rtsa sngags sham bur/ oṃ tsit+ta sid+dhi hoḥ slar yang slob dpon yi dam che ge mo ra gsal ba'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad phyag mtshan che ge mo 'i 'od zer thig le dang bcas pa'i rnam par 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas rtogs grol dus mnyam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgyud la zhugs par mos shig / phyag mtshan snying gar reg la/ thugs kyi rdo rje khyed la 'phos/ khyed sems rtog pa phyag rgya che// rtogs grol dus mnyam gyur byas nas// sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis med gyur// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes me tog dor bas byin rlabs brtan par bya/ slar yang gtor ma thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das che ge mo ra gsal ba'i gnas lnga las 'od zer lnga ldan 'phros khyed rang la thim pas bu khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ sku mi 'gyur ba oṃ/ gsung mi 'gyur ba āḥ thugs mi 'gyur ba hūm̐ du gyur te/ de yang chos kyi thig ler gyur/ thig le rtog bral phyag rgya chen por gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gtor ma gnas gsum du gtugs shing shis pa brjod/ de ltar yang*/ rgyud nag po klu 'dul las/ yi ge gsang ba'i rgyas gdab bya// zhes pa'i don yin la/ de nas phrin las cir spyod kyang*// yon tan 'byung ba'i rjes gnang sbyin// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ yon tan gyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ zhi ba la/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sogs longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i chas rnams kyis khyed rang lhar gsal ba'i sku la brgyan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sam/ khro bo la/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams kyis khyed rang khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku la yongs su brgyan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces zhi khro'i chas skabs bstun gtad la/ yon tan kun 'byung rgyan gyi dbang*// skyes bu khyed la bskur ba yis// sangs rgyas yon tan rab sgrub cing// thogs med 'gro don spyod par shog

/rat+na sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ de ltar yon tan kun 'byung rgyan gyis dbang bskur pas rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rin po che'i gter mdzod la dbang 'byor pa de nyid brtan par byas par mos shig /su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis me tog 'thor/ de nas phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ rang gzhan gyi don ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i mthu brtas shing*/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dpal thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phrin las bzhi mtshon byed lcags kyu la sogs pa'i tsaka li gtad nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las dbang*// skyes bu khyod la bskur ba yis// rgyal ba'i phrin las yongs bsgrub pa// 'gro don phyogs med spyod par shog /sarba karma dharma dhā tu hūm̐/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa me tog 'thor bas brtan par bya zhing*/ shis brjod ci rigs su spel lo// de dag gis lhag pa'i lha che ge mo 'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa legs par grub pa yin te/ rgyud las/ dbang thob yon tan bsam mtha' yas// dam srung rgyal sras kun gyi mchog /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs brjod mi lang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs dran par byas te/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung sdom bgyid par khas blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar bya'o// cho ga'i rjes rim sgrub thabs pad sdong ltar na bum lha la mchod bstod nongs bshags gshegs bsdu/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis bcas bya/ gsang ba gcig 'grub la tshogs rol zhing lhag ma sogs las byang mthar dbyung bas gzhan la'ang mtshon zhing rigs 'gre bar bya'o// byin rlabs kun gyi snying po 'dis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i rgyud smin cing*// 'phags pa klu dang pad+ma bzhin// dbang chen rdzogs par brnyes gyur cig

/'di'ang smin grol snying po'i gter gyi mdzod yongs su gang ba'i cha rkyen du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis rtsa ba'i gzhung dang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ma 'khrul ba bsdebs te bshad sgrub rtag brtan dar rgyas gling du bltas chog mar bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
